alerts.name: Elastic Cluster Red status
alerts.name_en: Elastic Cluster Red status
alerts.action:
1) 用 GET _cluster/health?level=indices 定位处于 red 的索引；
2) 用 GET _cluster/allocation/explain 看主分片无法分配的具体原因；
3) 常见原因是节点掉线，先把节点拉回集群让分片自动恢复；
4) 节点数据确实损坏时，用 POST _snapshot/<repo>/<snap>/_restore 从快照恢复该索引。

alerts.name: Elastic Cluster Yellow status
alerts.name_en: Elastic Cluster Yellow status
alerts.action:
1) 用 GET _cluster/allocation/explain 看副本分片无法分配的原因；
2) 单节点集群把索引副本数设为 0：PUT <index>/_settings {"index.number_of_replicas":0}；
3) 多节点集群检查是否有节点掉线、或磁盘触发了 watermark 导致不再分配；
4) 处理完确认 health 回到 green。

alerts.name: Elasticsearch disk out of space of the instance
alerts.name_en: Elasticsearch disk out of space of the instance
alerts.action:
1) 用 GET _cat/allocation?v 定位磁盘吃紧的节点；
2) 删除或归档过期索引（DELETE <index>），或用 ILM 把冷数据迁到冷节点；
3) 磁盘释放后手工解除只读：PUT _all/_settings {"index.blocks.read_only_allow_delete":null}；
4) 长期需扩容磁盘或增加数据节点。

alerts.name: Elasticsearch disk space low of the instance
alerts.name_en: Elasticsearch disk space low of the instance
alerts.action:
1) 用 GET _cat/allocation?v 看各节点磁盘水位；
2) 清理过期索引或调整 ILM 策略，提前把数据滚动到冷节点；
3) 评估 cluster.routing.allocation.disk.watermark.* 阈值是否与实际容量匹配；
4) 提前安排扩容，避免跌到 flood-stage 后索引被置为只读。

alerts.name: Elasticsearch Heap Usage Too High of the instance
alerts.name_en: Elasticsearch Heap Usage Too High of the instance
alerts.action:
1) 用 GET _nodes/stats/jvm 确认是哪个节点堆压力大；
2) 用 GET _cat/indices?v&s=store.size:desc 找占用大的索引，关闭或归档不用的；
3) 用 GET _tasks?actions=*search*&detailed 定位大聚合或深分页查询并 cancel；
4) 长期把堆调整为物理内存的一半（不超过 31G），或增加节点分摊。

alerts.name: Elasticsearch Heap Usage warning of the instance
alerts.name_en: Elasticsearch Heap Usage warning of the instance
alerts.action:
1) 对照 elasticsearch_jvm_gc_collection_seconds_count 看 old GC 是否变频繁；
2) 用 GET _cat/indices?v&s=store.size:desc 排查近期是否有索引数据量暴涨；
3) 用 GET _nodes/stats/indices/fielddata 检查 fielddata 与查询缓存占用；
4) 提前规划扩容或清理，避免涨到 90% 触发 Full GC。

alerts.name: Elasticsearch initializing shards of the instance
alerts.name_en: Elasticsearch initializing shards of the instance
alerts.action:
1) 用 GET _cat/recovery?v&active_only=true 看恢复进度是否还在推进；
2) 卡住不动时用 GET _cluster/allocation/explain 看原因（磁盘不足、节点带宽打满）；
3) 恢复限速可临时调高 indices.recovery.max_bytes_per_sec；
4) 确认没有节点在反复掉线导致分片反复重建。

alerts.name: Elasticsearch no new documents of the instance
alerts.name_en: Elasticsearch no new documents of the instance
alerts.action:
1) 先确认该集群本来就应持续写入，否则关闭此规则；
2) 检查上游写入端（Filebeat/Logstash/应用 bulk 客户端）是否存活、日志中是否有 bulk 被拒；
3) 用 GET _cat/thread_pool/write?v 看 write 线程池的 rejected 是否在增长；
4) 确认索引未被置为只读（磁盘 watermark 会触发 read_only_allow_delete）。

alerts.name: Elasticsearch pending tasks of the instance
alerts.name_en: Elasticsearch pending tasks of the instance
alerts.action:
1) 用 GET _cluster/pending_tasks 看积压的具体任务和优先级；
2) 用 GET _cat/master?v 确认 master 是否在频繁切换；
3) 用 GET _cat/shards 统计分片总数，排查是否因大量小索引导致集群状态过大；
4) 收敛分片数量（合并小索引、调整 ILM），必要时给 master 节点单独扩容。

alerts.name: Elasticsearch relocation shards of the instance
alerts.name_en: Elasticsearch relocation shards of the instance
alerts.action:
1) 用 GET _cat/recovery?v&active_only=true 看迁移是否还在推进；
2) 停滞则用 GET _cluster/allocation/explain 看是否被磁盘 watermark 或 allocation filter 挡住；
3) 确认是否有人手工触发了大规模 reroute，或有节点在上下线；
4) 必要时临时调高 cluster.routing.allocation.node_concurrent_recoveries 与恢复限速。

alerts.name: Elasticsearch unassigned shards of the instance
alerts.name_en: Elasticsearch unassigned shards of the instance
alerts.action:
1) 用 GET _cluster/allocation/explain 直接拿到未分配的原因；
2) 节点掉线则先把节点恢复回集群；
3) 副本数超过可用节点数则调小 index.number_of_replicas；
4) 磁盘触发 watermark 则先清理磁盘，再执行 POST _cluster/reroute?retry_failed=true。

collect.content:
# # collect interval
# interval = 15

############################################################################
# !!! uncomment [[instances]] to enable this plugin
[[instances]]
# # interval = global.interval * interval_times
# interval_times = 1

# append some labels to metrics
# labels = { cluster="cloud-n9e-es" }

## specify a list of one or more Elasticsearch servers
# servers = ["http://localhost:9200"]
servers = []

## Timeout for HTTP requests to the elastic search server(s)
http_timeout = "10s"

# either /_nodes/stats or /_nodes/_local/stats depending on this setting
local = false

## Set cluster_health to true when you want to obtain cluster health stats
cluster_health = true

## Adjust cluster_health_level when you want to obtain detailed health stats
## The options are
##  - indices (default)
##  - cluster
cluster_health_level = "cluster"

## Set cluster_stats to true when you want to obtain cluster stats.
cluster_stats = true

## Indices to collect; can be one or more indices names or _all
## Use of wildcards is allowed. Use a wildcard at the end to retrieve index names that end with a changing value, like a date.
# indices_include = ["zipkin*"]

## use "shards" or blank string for indices level
indices_level = ""

## node_stats is a list of sub-stats that you want to have gathered. Valid options
## are "indices", "os", "process", "jvm", "thread_pool", "fs", "transport", "http",
## "breaker". Per default, all stats are gathered.
node_stats = ["jvm", "breaker", "process", "os", "fs", "indices", "thread_pool", "transport"]

## HTTP Basic Authentication username and password.
username = "elastic"
password = "password"

## Optional TLS Config
# use_tls = false
# tls_ca = "/etc/categraf/ca.pem"
# tls_cert = "/etc/categraf/cert.pem"
# tls_key = "/etc/categraf/key.pem"
## Use TLS but skip chain & host verification
# insecure_skip_verify = true

## Sets the number of most recent indices to return for indices that are configured with a date-stamped suffix.
## Each 'indices_include' entry ending with a wildcard (*) or glob matching pattern will group together all indices that match it, and 
## sort them by the date or number after the wildcard. Metrics then are gathered for only the 'num_most_recent_indices' amount of most 
## recent indices.
num_most_recent_indices = 1
